user.title: Connect to ScopeDome Master card
user.description: Enter the card's local IPv4 address and HTTP password. Setup sends read-only commands only.

error.unsupported_status: The response is not the documented Master/Slave protocol layout.

init.title: Step 1 of 2: Contacts and rotation step
init.description: Check the shutter limits and dome Home switch in the ScopeDome driver's Shutters and Sensors tabs at known physical positions. Select each active input value only after verifying it. Enter a small, tested encoder pulse step for each left/right button press; 0 disables rotation buttons. Encoder pulses per turn must also be set on the next screen.

data.home_active_level: Dome Home switch active input (unknown, 0 or 1)
data.rotation_step_pulses: Dome rotation step in encoder pulses (0 disables)

azimuth.title: Step 2 of 2: Azimuth and cloud calibration
azimuth.description: Copy 'Encoder value for 360' from Config → Card and 'Home Sensor Position' plus the park angle from Config → Dome. Check whether the raw encoder count rises during clockwise or counterclockwise rotation. The card's documented reset value is 32000; verify it at Home. Cloud Index is a threshold in Config → Weather. Leave uncertain fields blank.

data.encoder_direction: Raw count increases during (unknown, CW or CCW)
